data.app_name: xFIT: Powered by World of Dance
data.description:
# Get ready for a whole new level of rhythm fitness with xFIT!

🔥 **GET THE RESULTS YOU WANT**

Fun workouts that build strength, improve cardio, and boost your overall wellness

🏆 **WORLD-CLASS TRAINERS**

Train with AI-powered coaches like fitness star Daisy Keech, TikTok icon Enola Bedard, Kida the Great, Josh Killacky - and more. Customize your trainer with 800+ options to match your style and motivation!

{1634209037192497}

🎶 **EXCLUSIVE MUSIC**

Feel the energy with electrifying beats and hard-hitting tracks, custom-created by top producers from the World of Dance team. Every track is designed to push you further and fuel your workout!

🕶️ **VR & MR AVAILABLE**

Step into the future with the most breathtaking, detailed environments ever seen in VR or transform your living space with Mixed Reality.

{949846587061520}

💪 **FULL-BODY FUN WORKOUTS**

Engage in high-intensity, rhythm-based, intuitive workouts that target every muscle group, keeping you strong, fit, and energized — while tracking every step with detailed health dashboards monitoring your progress.

{1278496559952887}

🧘 **COMPLETE WELLNESS**

Balance intense full-body workouts with calming wellness programs that help you recover, recharge, and stay centered on your fitness journey.

🚀 **LOADED WITH FEATURES**

xFIT is packed with everything you need: real-time multiplayer, viral clip editor, tournaments all around the globe, cutting-edge health dashboards, and so much more.


{1297681894978663}
